Item 1.
Business
Acme designs chips. Our largest customer, Beta Corp, buys most of our output. We rely on Gamma Foundry to manufacture our wafers.
We were founded in 1999 and employ 4,000 people in six countries around the world, mostly engineers.
Item 1A. Risk Factors

We depend on a single supplier, Gamma Foundry Ltd., for substantially all of our wafers. If it stopped supplying us we could not ship product.

Item 1A. Risk Factors (continued)

The loss of Beta Corp as a customer would harm us.

Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments
None.
Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis

Revenue grew 12% as demand recovered across all of our product lines.

Sales to our largest customer, Beta Corp, were 48% of revenue, up from 41% a year ago.

Operating expenses rose with hiring in research and development in the year.

Interest income was higher because of larger cash balances during the whole year.

Our tax rate was affected by one-off items recorded in the second quarter of the year.

Dividends were not paid.
